profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
My passions are in problem-solving, psychology, engineering, and offering accessible experiences for all web users. My purpose is to break down barriers in societal gender norms and to be the kindest human through continuous self-work. Being a female in a male dominated industry, pushing limits, and learning code has been quite the journey; I'm enjoying every bit of it. Always looking for ways to improve and innovate, I'm not afraid to say "I don't know" or to pitch some "crazy" idea. I'm humble in knowing I have much to learn and ambitious in reaching my goals. “The more I learn, the more I realize how much I don't know” is one of my favorite quotes as it rings so true.

Some have described me as the most passionate person they've met. Currently looking for a company that focuses on well-being, employee happiness and company culture, a team to whose sum is greater than its parts, and opportunities where my passions and ideas are welcomed.

In my personal time I study: all things psychology (including how to hack the brain), yoga philosophy and buddhism, happiness philosophy, mind-bending thought-provoking topics, math, and space (the infinite frontier). 

Positive emotions are contagious, which makes them a powerful tool in my quest for high performance in the workplace. Positive emotional contagion starts when people subconsciously mimic the body language, tone of voice, and facial expressions of those around them. Teams where one person sparked positive emotional contagion experienced less group conflict, more cooperation, and greater overall performance. Just one positive team member can affect both the individual attitudes and performance of those around them, as well as the dynamic and accomplishments of the group as a whole. I'm beaming with positivity, ask me about my ventures in gratitude and happiness!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
The fast-paced environment on the Campaigns and Community team, I worked on the front-end for special campaigns, including Team Canada for the Paris Olympics. This included modifying and customizing current components, creating new custom components, writing full A/B jest tests, SEO, and a11y compliance.

Accessibility focused role on the DAISY (Design and Interface Systems) Team.
Requiring deep understanding and knowledge of component usages on a product team focusing on design systems. Developing a component library consisting of 52 components and multiple supporting hooks and utilities for deliverable teams to consume. Our products encompass the overall product vision and all possible use cases implementing Atomic Design along with strict A11y/Level Access compliance and SEO optimization.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer II
positions.description:
Created and maintained components for large scale e-commerce solutions using Vue, React, Tailwind, Inertia, SQL, PHP, Blade, Sass, and Laravel. Migrated existing legacy code from PHP/Blade into Vue with Inertia. Using GitLab for version control and Jira for ticketing.
Work regularly with the client in planning and building proprietary in-house catering platform. Work closely with the Design team using Figma.

positions.title: Freelance Software Developer
positions.description: Self-study, self-improvement, personal development, and building applications for clients. This includes contract work in React using React Hooks and Material-UI, Javascript, Typescript, etc.

positions.title: Happiness Engineer / The Happiness Collective Lead Link
positions.description: Worked with then CEO Tony Hsieh to focus on a company wide Work Form Home culture. Research and Development around what psychology proves for well-being and productivity when working remotely while also focusing on tech's unique needs to develop a work from home culture specific to Tech. Hand selected and built an internal team of seven to cover different departments to discover/address areas of improvement/contention among teams, promote well-being during the work from home transition, and help facilitate a healthy working environment including stimulating connections, asking thought-provoking questions to encourage playful conversations, and planning virtual events.

positions.description:

Created and maintained components on the Landing Page/Header/Footer stack to improve customer experience using HTML, CSS, JS, and other web technologies. Wrote unit & end to end tests using Enzyme, Mocha, Chai, and Nightwatch. Migrated existing legacy code into React, staying up to date with new technology. Regularly found bugs in codebase, used GitHub enterprise to log and execute tickets. Performed some back end tasks including Amazon's CMS Symphony and Zappos Internal back end service ZCS.

Hackathon Winner 2020!
Small team of 5 where we created an online ordering system for the on-site Bistro. Similar to Uber Eats, the site included push notifications informing the user their food was available, daily specials and order status. Our team won 2 of 3 categories, including honorable mention (popular vote amongst Hackathon participants) and popular vote (popular vote amongst the company).

projects.title: Zappos Hackathon Winner
projects.description:
All of Zappos Tech was invited to work together in teams to build a project, whatever we wanted, to compete against other teams. Winner would receive a prize, notoriety, and funding for our project to go live.

Our team Stro2Go won 2 of the 3 categories including Honorable Mention (popular vote among Tech participants) and Overall Popular Vote.

On a team of five and with only one week, we developed an online ordering app for Zapponians to order food, cancel their order, update their order, see their order in real time at the on-site Zappos Bistro, and spread the word throughout Zappos suggesting participation in voting. The idea was to reduce the time waiting in line for the employees who had limited breaks and to maximize their break time to use other on-site facilities to promote well-being. Also allowing a wider variety of ordering options that were previously unknown reducing food waste and increasing options. It was a hit!
